def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    counts={v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in {x for row in grid for x in row} if v!=8}
    inside=max(counts,key=counts.get); border=min(counts,key=counts.get)
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if any(v!=8 for v in grid[r])]
    top,bottom=min(rows),max(rows); mid=(top+bottom)//2
    shift=sum(v!=8 for v in grid[mid+1])
    if border==4: shift=5
    top_cells=[c for c in range(w) if grid[top][c]!=8]
    top_shift=min(shift,8-min(top_cells)) if min(top_cells)+shift>8 else shift
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r<=mid: out[r][c]=8
            elif grid[r][c]==border: out[r][c]=inside
            elif grid[r][c]==inside: out[r][c]=border
    for r in range(top,mid+1):
        for c in range(w):
            v=grid[r][c]
            if v==border: out[r][c+(top_shift if r==top else shift)]=inside
            elif v==inside: out[r][c+(top_shift if r==top else shift)]=border
    return out
